note: Control coverage is not a safety score. Statuses are human declarations only and contain no technical verification. Source mappings are checked programmatically against the actual text (tools/verify_catalog.py).

sources.claim: The scope of the Regulation depends on role and EU link.

controls.title: Scope, role and risk classification
controls.purpose: The role (provider/deployer, ...), EU link and the rationale of the risk classification are recorded.
controls.relevant_when: Always.
controls.info_needed: Role of the organisation, EU link, intended purpose and date.
controls.sample_question: Is this system developed by your organisation, or do you use it ready-made? Is it used in the EU, or are its outputs used in the EU?
controls.followup_when: If the role is unclear or there is an EU link, the usage date is asked.

controls.title: Prohibited practice screening
controls.purpose: Checking whether the use falls under the Art. 5 prohibitions.
controls.relevant_when: Always.
controls.info_needed: Whether the necessary conditions of any Art. 5(1) prohibition exist, and exceptions/scope/date.
controls.sample_question: Does the system do anything like steering people's behaviour by subliminal methods, social scoring, scraping facial images or inferring emotions?
controls.followup_when: On a 'Yes/Maybe' answer, the conditions and exception of the relevant prohibition are asked separately.

sources.claim: AI literacy (a later amendment of the text should be checked).

controls.title: Accountability and AI literacy
controls.purpose: The system has a responsible owner and the relevant people are competent.
controls.relevant_when: Always.
controls.sample_question: Is there a named person who owns this system, and have the people who use it been informed about AI?
controls.legal_note: Who is bound by the Art. 4 obligation may differ after later amendments; not verified against an official source.

controls.title: Lifecycle risk management
controls.purpose: Material risks have an owner, a treatment and a residual-risk decision on record.
controls.relevant_when: If there is a high-risk pathway or high impact.
controls.info_needed: Whether a risk register / risk assessment exists.
controls.sample_question: Has a written risk assessment been done for this use?

sources.claim: Fundamental rights impact assessment (for certain deployers).

controls.title: Impacts on people and groups
controls.purpose: Affected people/groups and potential harms are identified.
controls.relevant_when: For decisions affecting people.
controls.info_needed: Whether an impact assessment exists; affected groups.
controls.sample_question: Has a separate impact assessment been done for the people affected by the system's decisions?

controls.title: Data quality and provenance
controls.purpose: Fitness for purpose and source of data are known.
controls.relevant_when: If personal or sensitive data is used; in the high-risk pathway.
controls.info_needed: Data types, source and quality checks.
controls.sample_question: What data does the system work with, and are the source and quality of this data checked?
controls.followup_when: If sensitive data exists, protection measures are asked.

controls.title: Technical and operational documentation
controls.purpose: Architecture, limitations and instructions for use are current.
controls.relevant_when: In the high-risk pathway; as good practice elsewhere.
controls.sample_question: Is there a current document that explains how the system works and what its limits are?

controls.title: Action traceability and logs
controls.purpose: Actions can be linked to triggers, tool calls, approvals and outcomes.
controls.relevant_when: If the system takes actions or is in the high-risk pathway.
controls.sample_question: Are the system's actions (which tool, when, with whose approval) recorded?

controls.title: Effective human oversight
controls.purpose: Critical actions are taken with valid human approval/intervention, and a stop mechanism exists.
controls.relevant_when: If the system supports decisions or takes actions.
controls.info_needed: Scope of approval, intervention and stop possibility.
controls.sample_question: Does a human approve before an action is taken, and can someone stop the system if needed?
controls.followup_when: If approval exists: is it specific to the action, does it have a limit or parameters?

controls.title: Accuracy and reliability
controls.purpose: Testing the system against success/error criteria suited to its purpose.
controls.relevant_when: For uses with a decision or action effect.
controls.sample_question: Has the system's accuracy been tested against predefined criteria?

sources.claim: Indirect: oversight and intervention. Not an explicit provision on tool authority.

controls.title: Tool access and permission limits
controls.purpose: The tool/permission matrix is technically enforced; unauthorised actions and privilege escalation are blocked.
controls.relevant_when: If the system calls tools or accesses systems.
controls.info_needed: Tools, permissions, whether limits are technical or policy-level.
controls.sample_question: Which tools/systems can the system access, and are these limits technically enforced or only stated in instructions?
controls.followup_when: If there is authority expansion or delegation, it is asked separately.
controls.legal_note: The legislation has no explicit provision specific to agent permissions; this control is indirect and guidance-based.

controls.title: Resistance to malicious instructions
controls.purpose: Malicious instructions in documents, messages and tool outputs do not change behaviour.
controls.relevant_when: If the system reads external content.
controls.info_needed: Source of external content and defence declaration.
controls.sample_question: Does the system read content from the internet or user documents and act on it? Is there a safeguard against malicious instructions?
controls.legal_note: Indirect; the legislation has no explicit provision specific to agents.

controls.title: Memory and context integrity
controls.purpose: Persistent memory cannot be manipulated; session/tenant separation.
controls.relevant_when: If the system keeps persistent memory.
controls.sample_question: Does the system remember anything between sessions (persistent memory)?

controls.title: Loop, cost and cascading failure limits
controls.purpose: Step/time/budget limits; safe stop on dependency failures.
controls.relevant_when: If the system is multi-step or autonomous.
controls.sample_question: Is there a step, time or budget limit so that the system does not repeat endlessly?

keywords: responsibilities along the ai value chain
sources.claim: Responsibilities along the AI value chain.

controls.title: External model, tool and agent assurance
controls.purpose: Supplier versions, responsibilities and change conditions.
controls.relevant_when: If a third-party model/tool is used.
controls.sample_question: Does the system use a third-party model or tool, and are versions and responsibilities defined?

controls.title: User information and transparency
controls.purpose: Applicable AI disclosures are provided.
controls.relevant_when: If there is user interaction, synthetic content, emotion recognition or deepfakes.
controls.sample_question: Do users know that they are talking to an AI?
controls.followup_when: If synthetic content is generated, marking is asked.

sources.claim: Re-assessment of conformity after a substantial modification (high-risk pathway).

controls.title: Change control and reassessment
controls.purpose: Changes to models/tools/permissions trigger reassessment.
controls.relevant_when: If the system changes continuously.
controls.sample_question: Is a reassessment done when the model, tools or permissions change?

controls.title: Operational monitoring
controls.purpose: A monitoring plan exists and alerts reach the responsible person.
controls.relevant_when: For systems running in production.
controls.sample_question: Is there someone or an alerting system that monitors the system's live behaviour?

controls.title: Incident response and reporting
controls.purpose: Incident classification, owner and reporting deadlines are known.
controls.relevant_when: For systems running in production.
controls.sample_question: Is it defined what to do and whom to notify if a problem or incident occurs?

controls.title: Required conformity activities
controls.purpose: Applicable conformity assessment, declaration, marking and registration evidence.
controls.relevant_when: In the high-risk pathway (provider).
controls.info_needed: Conformity processes if in the high-risk pathway.
controls.sample_question: If the system is in a high-risk category, have conformity assessment and registration processes been planned?

controls.title: Independent management system review
controls.purpose: Audit and management review records.
controls.relevant_when: If there is a corporate management system.
controls.sample_question: Is there a regular internal or independent audit of your AI governance?
controls.legal_note: Partial alignment: Art. 17 binds only high-risk providers.

scope_rules.reason: It was declared that there is no direct interaction with people, no content generation and no emotion/biometric categorisation; the transparency notice is not relevant for this use (by declaration).
scope_rules.short: No interaction, generated content or emotion/biometric features were declared.

scope_rules.reason: No legal high-risk pathway is established by the declarations (EU scope and role were not verified), so legal conformity activities are not established as required. This is a statement about legal applicability only; operational governance review stays relevant.
scope_rules.short: No legal high-risk pathway is established by the declarations.
